question: On the already frozen all-universe 15-day 4h snapshot, which of the 1,764 structurally legal YOLO boxes and 221 deduplicated control events survive the exact causal semantic gate accepted on chronological pre-holdout 15m validation?
single_variable: Add the already frozen deterministic causal semantic-gate decision after the existing structural YOLO filter. Frozen candle bytes, universe, 1,764 source boxes, weights, confidence=0.25, NMS=0.70, W18/W19, box-to-core mapping, core4/5, post2-9 and five-bar event gap remain identical.

owner_authorization.prompt_scope_immediately_preceding_autho: 批准本配置消费一次 4h holdout，并重扫最近半个月。
owner_authorization.interpreted_scope: Apply the locked semantic gate once to the previously frozen 4h recent-half-month scan and redraw every surviving event with the complete frozen future visible.

frozen_source.candle_hash_contract: Verify all 273 per-symbol CSV hashes against summary.fetch_audits before scoring; materialize OHLCV only for symbols with structural candidates.

treatment.description: Keep a structural 4h box only when it passes every original training-semantic predicate whose required candle is already visible at the exact saved W18/W19 endpoint.
treatment.future_visibility_rule: Physically slice each numeric gate input at window_end_i. Candles after window_end_i may be rendered later in the review-only gallery but cannot enter a gate feature.

experimental_design.assignment: Every frozen structural box receives both actual-direction and direction-flipped semantic calculations; no random assignment is required because both are deterministic paired views of the same box.
pairing_units: each of 221 source control events with exhaustive non-overlapping candidate membership
primary_outputs: actual-direction box survival and predicate failures
treatment re-deduplicated event count and full event list
all surviving events rendered with complete frozen future K-lines
experimental_design.null_control: Keep candle bytes, box geometry, class, confidence, W endpoint and event membership fixed; invert only LONG/SHORT inside the semantic calculation.
experimental_design.pseudoreplication_control: Report both box and source-event levels; do not treat W18/W19 and adjacent endpoints from one event as independent signals.

decision_rule.execution_pass: All frozen hashes, exact input pixels, 1,764 gate rows, 221 control-event memberships and output receipts replay without drift.
decision_rule.semantic_direction_coherence: Actual-direction box survival must exceed direction-flipped survival with paired exact two-sided p < 0.01.
decision_rule.count_handling: Deliver the locked result unchanged whether zero, few or many events survive; no minimum count and no threshold relaxation.
decision_rule.failure_action: Report failure unchanged. Do not inspect charts to alter any threshold, retrain, promote, deploy, or rerun a variant on this holdout.
